item.title: DanMachi: Frontier Zero Is a New Game for PC and Mobile in 2027, With an Original Story by Fujino Omori
item.description:
enish has announced Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? Frontier Zero, a new DanMachi game for PC, iOS and Android. It is set for 2027, in Japan and overseas, and its main story is an original written with the help of series author Fujino Omori.
The Japanese title is Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka: Frontier Zero. Its logo carries the Familia Myth subtitle used across the franchise.
The main draw so far is the plot. enish says Frontier Zero tells a DanMachi story that has not appeared in the light novels or the anime, and that Omori is working with the team on it. Nothing has been said yet about which characters lead it or where it falls in the timeline.
The game will be cross-platform between smartphones and PC. enish has not revealed its genre, how it plays or how it will be monetized, so whether it uses gacha is still unannounced. The DanMachi Frontier Zero 2027 window is the only date given so far.
The announcement came from the game’s official X account, which is where enish says the next details will appear:
Frontier Zero arrives a year after the previous DanMachi mobile title, DanMachi – Battle Chronicle, shut down in Japan and worldwide on September 29, 2025.

item.title: CookieRun: Kingdom and Crumble × The Amazing Digital Circus Crossover Runs Until November 19
item.description:
Each game gets its own story, and the two split the cast differently: Kingdom makes two of them playable, while Crumble makes all seven playable and adds Bubble as a pet.
In Kingdom, Pomni Cookie and Jax Cookie join as Special Cookies you can recruit and keep. Ragatha, Gangle, Zooble, Kinger and Caine Cookie appear as Guest Cookies for the duration of the event.
The story starts with a coding error that drops the circus crew and their tent into the Cookie Kingdom. As glitches spread and distort the world, the Cookies team up with the crew to fight off monsters, find the source of the error and send them home. The event also adds a boss raid against the Abstracted, decor pieces taken from the series such as the Circus Stage and Zooble’s Bar Table, collab-only costumes and MyCookie icing sets.
Devsisters’ update trailer for Kingdom:
Crumble goes further. Every member of the cast is a playable Special Cookie, released in two batches: Pomni, Caine, Ragatha and Kinger from October 22, then Jax, Zooble and Gangle on November 5. Caine’s assistant Bubble joins as a Special pet.
Here the circus tent crashes into the Choco Drop Kingdom, and Caine leads Pomni, Jax and Bubble in fixing a dimensional error. The event dungeon climbs in difficulty stage by stage, with circus characters fighting alongside you, and each clear pays out a collab currency you can trade for Cookies and items in the exchange shop. A harder Night Circus Tent difficulty opens with the second wave on November 5. If you are deciding where the new Cookies fit in a team, our CookieRun: Crumble tier list covers the current roster.
Devsisters says the CookieRun games have passed 300 million cumulative users and 1.5 trillion won in total revenue. The Amazing Digital Circus, created by Gooseworx with Glitch Productions, ended its nine-episode run in June 2026 with more than 1.5 billion YouTube views and around 100 million hours watched on Netflix.
“The Amazing Digital Circus, with its bold imagination, whimsical characters, and passionate fandom, shares many things in common with Cookie Run,” said Devsisters CEO Cho Kil-hyun. Glitch Productions co-founder Luke Lerdwichagul called the crossover a way to bring the series to new audiences and give both fanbases something new.
Guides, data and news for this game, all in one place.

item.title: Solo Leveling: ARISE 2.5th Anniversary Update BEYOND Is Out With Go Gunhee, Velvet and 500 Free Draws
item.description:
The game also passed 70 million cumulative players around two and a half years after its global launch, and Netmarble Neo is using this update to rework how progression feels: Special Commission is gone, Sung Jinwoo’s level cap goes up and a new growth system rewards beating the hardest bosses.
Holy Guardian Barrier Go Gunhee is a Water Buster and a new take on the Hunters Association chairman. His kit leans on the four guardian beasts: Echo strikes with the power of the Black Tortoise, Waterspout calls on the Azure Dragon and his Burst skill, Heaven-Crushing Strike, hits the whole area around him.
Velvet is a Fire Successor who inherits the ferocity of Adan, the Monarch of Fangs. Her exclusive weapon, Play of Fangs, is a double-bladed spear made from two swords that splits back into dual blades mid-fight. Roar of the Pack pulls enemies together and launches them, Fang Cleave follows up with the swords, and her Ultimate, Pandemonium, sweeps the area. Players deciding whether either is worth their tickets can compare them with the current roster in our Solo Leveling: Arise tier list.
The headline mode is Deep Containment Zone, the first challenge where you field four Hunters instead of three. Teams fight Experiment bosses, harder variants of familiar enemies that add shockwaves, extra spawns and hazards like collapsing zones and gas leaks. It unlocks after beating Igris on Expert and opens as a beta, with Experiment Igris (weak to Water) and Experiment Kargalgan (weak to Wind) rotating every two weeks. A gauge-based combo system called Union unleashes one powerful skill per battle, with extra effects depending on the classes on your team.
The rest of the update reshapes long-term growth:
Netmarble opened the celebration with its 2.5th anniversary PV:
Netmarble is handing out up to 300 Special Draw Tickets through the October update and up to 200 more with the November update. The celebration events add 10,000 Essence Stones and 20 Rate Up Draw Tickets, and the time-limited dungeon Battlefield of Infinity asks you to defeat as many bosses as possible before the clock runs out, paying out Essence Stones, Rate Up Draw Tickets, event materials and Gold by stage.
The redeem code 25THANNIV, announced on the official Solo Leveling: ARISE account, works from October 22 and grants a 2.5th Anniversary SSR Hunter plus an exclusive weapon selection ticket. If you are planning how far those tickets go, the Solo Leveling: Arise Pity Calculator shows the odds and Essence Stone cost of reaching pity.
One platform change lands on the same day: Netmarble’s notices list October 22 as the end of support for the Epic Games Store version.

item.title: Mabinogi Mobile Announces a Jujutsu Kaisen Collab for November 5, and [Oshi no Ko] for Japan
item.description:
NEXON has announced two anime collaborations for Mabinogi Mobile: Jujutsu Kaisen arrives in the Korean version on November 5 and in the Taiwanese version on November 4, while the Japanese version gets [Oshi no Ko] from November 4. So far, each collab has only been announced for those regions.
Both were revealed on October 21 with short teasers. NEXON has not yet listed the characters or items in either one; for [Oshi no Ko], the full details go up on a special site on October 28.
The Korean teaser shows the silhouettes of five Jujutsu High students against the date 11.05, with Yuji Itadori throwing a punch wrapped in blue cursed energy. NEXON’s tagline calls it a domain expansion unfolding in Erinn and a special-grade collab across dimensions. The Mabinogi Mobile Jujutsu Kaisen content list is due later.
Taiwan runs the same collab one day earlier, on November 4, and NEXON has said the details for both regions will follow.
The Japanese collab arrives less than a month after Mabinogi Mobile launched in Japan on October 7. Its tagline is “Let’s support our oshi in Erinn”, and the teaser follows Ai Hoshino as she walks into the spotlight on stage before the camera closes in on her star-shaped eyes.
According to the official notice, the event runs from the maintenance on November 4 until 05:59 JST on December 16, 2026.
The collab items come from lucky boxes, the game’s gacha for outfits and pets, and these can only be opened with the collab’s own tickets: the [Oshi no Ko] Fashion Ticket and the [Oshi no Ko] Pet Ticket. The regular Premium Fashion and Premium Pet Tickets do not work on them.

item.title: Kita Kita Ousama Launches October 22 in Japan After 2.27 Million Pre-Registrations
item.description:
EFUN will launch Kita Kita Ousama (King Kita Kita), a merge RPG built around luck and split-second decisions, on October 22 on iOS and Android in Japan. Pre-registration passed 2.27 million sign-ups before launch, which hit the final goal and unlocked every reward.
EFUN announced the Kita Kita Ousama release date in an official press release on October 15. Pre-registration, open since September 17, is still taking sign-ups until launch.
The game sells itself on one idea: explosive luck and snap decisions, and its slogan even rhymes “fortune” with “gacha”. Randomness drives every fight, and the skill is in reacting to it fast: the game’s own screens describe a chain of choices between summoning new units, upgrading the ones you have and merging them into stronger ones.
The other half of the pitch is the comeback. EFUN promotes the game with the promise that one lucky roll can turn a fight around in a single move, and the boss battles are where that matters most.
The campaign is fronted by singer ano, the game’s official ambassador, who stars in two TV commercials. The game needs Android 15 or iOS 12 or later, and EFUN will share launch-day news and events on the official Kita Kita Ousama X account in the run-up to October 22.
EFUN’s pre-registration trailer introduces the king and the merge battles.

item.title: HYPNOSYNC, the Hypnosis Rhythm Game, Launches October 28 on PC, iOS and Android
item.description:
BASED KICK has set the launch of HYPNOSYNC, its rhythm game about hypnotizing arcade customers, for October 28 at 19:00 JST. The game arrives the same day on PC through Steam, the App Store and Google Play.
The HYPNOSYNC release date came in an official Steam announcement on October 18. The game is free to play, with paid currency and items, and the developer has made clear there will be no paid songs.
You play the new manager of an arcade called HYPNOSYNC, hired against your will by a boss named Nezzie. Every song has a customer to hypnotize: their willpower comes down a single lane in five colors, and you break it as it reaches the line. Do it well enough and the customer becomes one of your employees.
Reaching Daze Mode during a song opens Daze Challenges, and beating them earns Daze Tickets. Those tickets are spent in the Deep Dive Draw, the game’s gacha. Employees can then become partners who help with their own skills, and you can talk to them between shifts.
The game supports English, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese. Its Steam page carries a content note for suggestive outfits and expressions, and states that all characters are adults.
BASED KICK first introduced the game with this teaser.
The open playtest on Steam, available since February, ends on October 25. Progress from it does not carry over to the full game.

item.title: Haikyuu!! ALL Challengers Opens Pre-Registration on iOS and Android in Japan
item.description:
TOHO Games, the game label of Japanese film studio TOHO, has opened pre-registration for Haikyuu!! ALL Challengers on the App Store and Google Play in Japan. The mobile game is the first full training simulation based on the Haikyuu!! anime, and G2 Studios develops and runs it.
The Haikyuu ALL Challengers pre-registration opened on October 20 together with a new main visual, a new trailer and a relaunched official website. There is no release date yet.
Each run starts with a player and a plan. You decide which stats to push, put together practice menus to raise them, and then field the players you have trained in a team of your own to play matches, which run automatically. The roster on the official site already covers Karasuno, Nekoma and Shiratorizawa, with Hinata, Kageyama, Kuroo and Kenma among the first names.
Training mode also tells a story for each school and character, fully voiced with newly recorded lines. The cards you bring into training add their own bonuses, and every one of them uses newly drawn illustrations; the strongest moves, called super plays, get 2D animated sequences made for each character.
TOHO Games released a new official trailer alongside the store pages, introducing the game and its Karasuno line-up.
Rewards grow with the number of sign-ups. The tiers revealed so far include 1,000 V-Gems and a guaranteed SP gacha ticket, plus a prize draw for a set of original can badges. Sign-ups are open on the Japanese App Store and Google Play.

item.title: Princess Connect! Re:Dive × Uma Musume Collab Starts October 31 With a Free Gold Ship
item.description:
Cygames has detailed the crossover between two of its own games, Princess Connect! Re:Dive and Uma Musume Pretty Derby. The Princess Connect Uma Musume collab starts on October 31 at 12:00 JST and runs until November 23 at 4:59 JST, with four horse girls joining the cast and one of them free for every player.
The crossover is in the Japanese version of the game; the English version closed in 2023. Cygames presented it in a livestream on October 17 and confirmed the details in an official announcement two days later.
The collab story event is called “Daibakusou! Princess Derby: Magic, Fire, Sea and Sky!?”. Gold Ship drags Almond Eye, Lucky Lilac and Daring Tact into Legend of Astrum, the game world where Princess Connect takes place, and then disappears. When the others find her, she has split into several tiny copies of herself, and the three set off across Landosol with the Gourmet Edifice guild to put her back together.
Taking part in the event unlocks Gold Ship, voiced by Hitomi Ueda, at no cost. A training mission that opens at the same time, on October 31 at 12:00 JST, hands out the memory pieces needed to raise her to 5 stars, along with upgrade materials.
The limited collab gacha opens on October 31 at 12:00 JST with Almond Eye, voiced by Kaori Ishihara. Lucky Lilac (Yuki Nakashima) and Daring Tact (Hina Youmiya) are also confirmed as limited collab units; Cygames will give their banner dates on the official Princess Connect! Re:Dive X account and in the in-game notices.
The full October 17 broadcast, with the story trailer and the new units in action, is archived on the official Princess Connect! Re:Dive channel.

item.title: Grisaia: The Hundred Fruits of Gathering Opens Pre-Registration in Japan Ahead of a 2026 Release
item.description:
Grisaia: The Hundred Fruits of Gathering (Grisaia Shuuketsu no Hyakka), the new smartphone game in the Grisaia visual novel series, opened pre-registration in Japan on October 16, 2026 on the App Store and Google Play. Developer CLYRE plans to release it before the end of 2026.
It is a free-to-play character-raising simulation game with in-app purchases, and it brings together characters from across the series, from Grisaia no Kajitsu to Grisaia: Phantom Trigger, alongside six new girls created for this game.
Good Smile Company and Frontwing revealed the game on February 25, 2026, the day the series turned 15. The first entry, Grisaia no Kajitsu, came out on February 25, 2011, and the main trilogy follows Yuuji Kazami and the girls of Mihama Academy. CLYRE is in charge of development and will also run the game.
The official announcement of the Grisaia pre-registration came eight months after that reveal. Sign-ups go through the official store link, and the game needs iOS 15 or Android 9.0 and up.
The plot starts when six mysterious girls appear in front of Amane and the others, each claiming to be Yuuji Kazami’s daughter. They should be living 20 years in the future, yet they are somehow in the present. At the same time, a terrorist group calling itself the new Gaia Order declares war on government organizations including CIRS and SORD, led by a man named Heath Oslo whose silhouette looks very much like Yuuji.
Returning heroines include Yumiko Sakaki, Amane Suou, Michiru Matsushima, Makina Irisu, Sachi Komine and Kazuki Kazami, next to the six newcomers: Yuuma Sakaki, Yuuki Suou, Ichiru Matsushima, Serina Irisu, Yukiho Komine and Hifumi Kazami. Each one shares a family name with one of the original heroines.
The teaser released with the February reveal introduces the six girls and the new threat:
The game is built around raising each character and customizing her to your liking, winning battles for rewards and climbing the rankings. There is also a guild versus guild mode where players send their favorite girls into battle against other guilds.
The theme song is 「グレイズブレンダー」, sung by Yoshino Nanjo, with lyrics by Yuichi Kuwashima and music and arrangement by Jin Fujima of Elements Garden, the team behind earlier Grisaia songs. Its full music video is already out:
A separate visual novel set in the same story, Grisaia no Shinkajitsu -Shuuketsu no Hyakka-, is also in the works for 2027.

item.title: Monster Hunter Puzzles: Felyne Isles Ends Service on January 14, 2027, and an Offline Version Keeps Your Save
item.description:
Capcom has announced the end of service for Monster Hunter Puzzles: Felyne Isles, its match-3 puzzle game for iOS and Android. Online features go offline on January 14, 2027, and in-game purchases stop two months earlier, on November 12, 2026.
The game is not disappearing completely. On November 12 Capcom releases Monster Hunter Puzzles: Felyne Isles Furever, an offline version that players can move their current save into, and it will also come to Nintendo Switch and Steam.
The official end of service notice splits the closure into two steps:
Gems and boosters bought before the cutoff can still be used until January 14. After that date, the parts of the original app that do not need a connection keep working, but Capcom will no longer support it.
Felyne Isles Furever is a fully offline edition of the game. Progress carries over through each device’s cloud backup, iCloud on iOS and Google Cloud on Android, and Capcom will publish the step-by-step transfer guide closer to the date.
There are a few conditions to keep the save:
Capcom also warns that some features change in Furever, so part of the data will not carry over or will be converted. A connection is still needed at startup to confirm the content.
The Monster Hunter Puzzles shutdown closes a game that launched worldwide in June 2024. Players guide the Felynes through match-3 stages, push back monsters such as Rathalos, collect materials and spend them on outfits and on rebuilding their island.
The Switch and Steam versions of Furever do not have a release date yet. Capcom says it will share it later.
